_comment: Guided tour for the Count Rate Analysis tool. Steps point at real controls; the ones the user must press wait for the press.

steps.title: Queue the files
steps.text: The tool reports one count rate per detector channel over many TTTR files. Press Add files (or drop files or a folder on the window) to queue them; Folder and Database queue whole sets.

await.hint: Press Add files and choose one or more TTTR files.

steps.title: Define the channels
steps.text: The detector setup decides which routing channels and micro-time gates make up each reported channel. Pick a saved setup or edit one here; the results use exactly these channels.

steps.title: Calculate
steps.text: Counts the photons of every channel in every file on a background thread and divides by the measurement time. Stop analysis appears while it runs.

steps.title: Read the table
steps.text: One row per channel: mean and standard deviation of the rate over the files, the photons and the total time. A large standard deviation means the rate drifts between files; the plot shows it file by file.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Writes the table as tab-separated text.

await.hint: Press Save and choose a file name.
